mapper.select: SELECT StoryId FROM dbo.vw_PublicStory WHERE Slug = #{slug}

SELECT s.StoryId, s.Slug, s.Title, s.Description, s.CoverUrl, s.CompletionStatus, s.AgeRating, s.ChapterCount, s.WordCount, s.ViewCount, s.FollowCount, s.RatingAvg, s.RatingCount, s.LastChapterAt, s.PublishedAt, a.UserId AS Author_AuthorId, a.PenName AS Author_PenName, a.IsVerified AS Author_IsVerified FROM dbo.vw_PublicStory s JOIN dbo.Author a ON a.UserId = s.AuthorId WHERE s.StoryId = #{storyId}
SELECT g.GenreId, g.Name, g.Slug, sg.IsPrimary FROM dbo.StoryGenre sg JOIN dbo.Genre g ON g.GenreId = sg.GenreId WHERE sg.StoryId = #{storyId} ORDER BY sg.IsPrimary DESC, g.SortOrder, g.GenreId
SELECT t.TagId, t.Name, t.Slug FROM dbo.StoryTag st JOIN dbo.Tag t ON t.TagId = st.TagId WHERE st.StoryId = #{storyId} ORDER BY t.Name

SELECT v.VolumeId, v.VolumeNo, v.Title, c.ChapterId AS Chapter_ChapterId, c.ChapterNo AS Chapter_ChapterNo, c.Title AS Chapter_Title, c.PublishedAt AS Chapter_PublishedAt FROM dbo.Volume v JOIN dbo.Chapter c ON c.VolumeId = v.VolumeId AND c.StoryId = v.StoryId AND c.Status = 'PUBLISHED' AND c.IsDeleted = 0 WHERE v.StoryId = #{storyId} ORDER BY v.VolumeNo, c.ChapterNo
SELECT ChapterId, ChapterNo, Title, PublishedAt FROM dbo.Chapter WHERE StoryId = #{storyId} AND VolumeId IS NULL AND Status = 'PUBLISHED' AND IsDeleted = 0 ORDER BY ChapterNo
